snippet.title: Balkan Horror Tales Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a folklore-inspired horror survival narrative rooted in Eastern European legends. Experience the eerie atmosphere of the Eastern European nature alongside iconic horror figures like Baba Yaga and the Sack Man. Navigate through the detailed setting and lifestyle, uncovering more of the immersive storyline and make your own decision that will determine your fate in this gripping tale.

Play the game now on itch.io: https://s-v-m.itch.io/balkan-horror-tales

About.

The game is designed and developed by Stefan Markovski and Harry Vallance as a part of the MA Games and Playful Design and MSc Computer Games (Programming) courses in Goldsmiths, University of London. 

This project was developed using the Unity 2022.28 Game Engine. Harry took on the challenging role of programming the majority of the systems and mechanics, while also creating a remarkable tool for branching narrative development to assist game designers in crafting similar experiences. Stefan was responsible for designing the game's concept and narrative, as well as managing the project, including work distribution and establishing the work environment. 

As a two-person team, we successfully implemented everything we set out to achieve. We are proud to showcase Balkan Horror Tales as the culmination of our master's degrees.
